description.p: A beautiful screenshot tool. Press Super+Shift+S anywhere: the screen freezes, you select an area or a window, and it's copied, ready to paste.

ul.li: Annotate right on the frozen screen: arrows, boxes, pen, highlighter, text and pixelate
Record an area or the whole screen, with microphone and system sound; the controls stay out of the video
Trim a recording and share it as a video or a GIF
Pin a capture above every window while you work

description.p: Works on GNOME, KDE Plasma, COSMIC, niri, Sway, Hyprland, river and X11 sessions. Everything stays on your computer: no account, no network, no telemetry.

screenshot.caption: Point it out: arrows, text and highlights right on the frozen screen
Record a part of the screen; the controls stay out of the video
Trim a recording and copy it as a GIF

description.p: A new app ID (xyz.kustik.Screenshot), screenshots and details for software centers, and the GNOME 51 runtime.
